Hymn 263: Go Forth with Faith
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: A. Laurence Lyon
Lyricist/Text Author: Ruth Muir Gardner
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 263 titled "Go Forth with Faith" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by A. Laurence Lyon and the lyrics were written by Ruth Muir Gardner.
